verdict.rationale: Fellow says every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript. It also offers Ask Fellow and MCP-based Q&A across past meetings, and its transcripts are diarized and timestamped. No evidence documents a unified search across transcripts, summaries and notes, or a click-through that jumps playback to the exact moment a phrase was said. Missing for 10: documented cross-meeting search spanning summaries and notes, jump-to-timestamp playback from search results, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
